home.findText: Tell Youssef the brand, model and preferred year range.
home.commissionText: The commission terms are being confirmed with the owner. Ask for the full terms before making a decision.

forms.sellIntro: Share the required details. Your message will be prepared in WhatsApp; this website does not upload or store it.
forms.findIntro: Tell Youssef what you are looking for. Your message opens in WhatsApp and is sent only when you choose to send it.
forms.consent: I agree that these details are sent to Youssef Hany through WhatsApp so he can reply to me. I have read the Privacy Policy.
forms.age: You must be 18 or older to use this form.
forms.photos: After WhatsApp opens, attach your photos in the chat. This site cannot upload photos.
forms.required: Please complete the required fields and agree to the consent notice.
forms.whatsappNote: WhatsApp is a third-party service. Its own terms and privacy policy apply when you use it.

pages.aboutText: Youssef Hany helps visitors enquire about listed luxury and exotic cars, discuss selling a car, or request help finding a specific model.
pages.faq1a: No. This is an inventory showcase and contact website. Purchases and payments do not happen on this website.
pages.faq2a: No. Prices and availability can change. Confirm with Youssef before you decide.
pages.faq3a: This website does not make claims about inspections, warranties or financing. Ask about any terms directly before proceeding.
pages.contactText: Use the verified details once the owner has re-confirmed them. Contact and social details currently require owner verification.
pages.legalDraft: This page is a draft based on the website's current planned operation. It must be reviewed and completed by the owner and a qualified Egyptian lawyer before launch.
pages.privacyText: This static website does not send form data to a server. If you choose to open WhatsApp, the message is handled by WhatsApp/Meta under its own terms and privacy policy. This site does not sell personal data or run analytics or advertising trackers.
pages.termsText: Listings are informational, and are not a binding offer or reservation. Prices and availability can change. Confirm with Youssef before you decide. No purchase or payment takes place on this website. Any transaction terms are agreed directly between the parties.
pages.feesText: This website does not take payments. The previously stated 1% commission has not been confirmed. Before any transaction, ask who pays the commission, what amount it is calculated on, when it is due, and whether tax or other charges apply. No refund or deposit promise is made here.
pages.cookiesText: This site does not use cookies, analytics, advertising trackers, fingerprinting, or third-party scripts. It may store one language preference in localStorage only when you switch language.
pages.credits: Fonts and build dependencies must be licensed and self-hosted before launch.

footer.disclaimer: Listings are informational. Confirm price, availability and terms directly before proceeding.
